summary: Tested all newly-added features: web push (subscribe/unsubscribe + VAPID key), in-app notifications (list + mark-read), approved-app PDF persistence + download (owner/admin/forbidden/unauth/non-approved), rejection flow with admin_notes surfaced in /api/notifications, auth regressions, PWA assets (manifest/sw.js/icons/index head), service-worker registration, and frontend dashboard + ApplicationDetails approved/rejected cards. 17/17 backend pytest cases passed. Frontend playwright flow passed for PWA + apply-passport + approved download. Two bugs surfaced: (1) /api/applications/{id} strips admin_notes via Pydantic model so the rejected card never shows the admin reason; (2) dashboard shows both 'Enable Push Notifications' button AND 'Notifications blocked' badge when permission is denied.

critical.issue: Pydantic VisaApplication model has no admin_notes field and ConfigDict(extra='ignore'), so admin_notes is silently dropped from the response. Frontend ApplicationDetails rejection-notice therefore always falls back to the generic message and never shows the admin's reason. Same issue affects /api/applications and /api/admin/applications. /api/notifications is unaffected because it does a raw projection.

ui_bugs.issue: When Notification.permission==='denied', both the 'Enable Push Notifications' button and the 'Notifications blocked' badge render side-by-side. The enable button's gating condition is `notifPermission !== 'granted'` and should be `notifPermission === 'default'` so it disappears once the user has denied permission.
Line 82 has a stray `self.appAddEventListener = self.addEventListener.bind(self);` — looks like leftover/dead code. Safe to remove. Does not affect SW registration or push handling.

POST /api/push/subscribe requires auth (401 unauth) and 200 + ok=true with cookie; idempotent upsert by endpoint
PUT /api/admin/applications/{id}/status status=approved persists base64 PDF (visa_document) and resets status_seen_at
GET /api/notifications returns approved+rejected unread items including admin_notes for rejected
POST /api/notifications/{id}/read returns ok=true and clears it from next /api/notifications response; 404 for non-existent id
GET /api/applications/{id}/visa-pdf for approved app returns application/pdf with attachment Content-Disposition and starts with %PDF
GET /api/applications/{id}/visa-pdf returns 401 unauth, 403 for other users, 400 for not-yet-approved
Auth regression: register + admin login still work; vnovruz@dohacollege.com.qa cannot login (removed)
PWA: /manifest.json, /sw.js (javascript MIME), /icon-192.png, /icon-512.png served at preview URL
PWA: index.html includes <link rel='manifest' href='/manifest.json'> and apple-touch-icon
PWA: navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration('/') returns reg with scope '/' and scriptURL=/sw.js
Dashboard shows enable-notifications-button when permission != granted
Dashboard shows download-pdf-N button on approved row; clicking triggers .pdf download
ApplicationDetails rejected: rejection-notice visible (but admin_notes text not shown — see bug above)
action_items: FIX: Add `admin_notes: Optional[str] = None` (and likely `visa_document: Optional[dict] = None`, `status_changed_at: Optional[datetime] = None`, `status_seen_at: Optional[datetime] = None`) to the VisaApplication Pydantic model in /app/backend/server.py so admin_notes is returned by GET /api/applications/{id}. Without this, the rejection-notice card in ApplicationDetails.js can never show the rejection reason — only the generic fallback paragraph.

FIX (low priority): In /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.js change the enable-notifications-button condition from `notifPermission !== 'granted'` to `notifPermission === 'default'` so the button disappears once permission has been denied (currently both enable button and blocked badge render together).
CLEANUP (cosmetic): Remove dead line `self.appAddEventListener = self.addEventListener.bind(self);` from /app/frontend/public/sw.js.
critical_code_review_comments: VisaApplication response model is over-restrictive — admin_notes (and all other writes done via $set such as visa_document/status_changed_at/status_seen_at) are stripped by `extra='ignore'`. Either declare them as Optional fields on the model or return raw dicts.
Dashboard's notification permission UI has overlapping conditions (`!== 'granted'` collides with the `=== 'denied'` branch).
send_push_to_user is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task — fine, but failures are only logged. Consider surfacing failed pushes to monitoring; not a blocker.

PDF generation runs inline (sync to_thread is not used) inside the admin status PUT handler before the DB update; this can take 5-15s due to OpenAI call. Consider moving into the background task to keep the admin endpoint snappy. Not a correctness bug.

After main agent fixes (a) VisaApplication model to include admin_notes and (b) Dashboard enable-button condition, retest by: (1) re-running pytest -v test_push_pdf_notifications.py and (2) UI-checking that /applications/{rejected_id} now shows the 'Reason: ...' line inside [data-testid='rejection-notice']. The rest of the surface area (PWA, push subscribe, PDF download, approval card) is verified working.
rca of the issue: Root cause for missing admin_notes on rejection page: backend `class VisaApplication(BaseModel)` declares only the legacy fields and uses `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='ignore')`. Endpoints like GET /api/applications/{id} fetch the raw mongo doc (which DOES contain admin_notes after rejection) and pass it through `VisaApplication(**app)`; FastAPI then serializes only the model fields, dropping admin_notes. The frontend ApplicationDetails.js renders `application.admin_notes` correctly when present, so the fix is purely on the backend Pydantic model.
